set.body:
Source: https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/natural-features/issues/9
Outcome: optional audio.music.mert extractor returning FeatureSeries(time, layer, unit), preserving selected layer order and native units.
Proposed paths: new src/natural_features/features/audio/mert.py; audio/__init__.py; zoo/specs/core_extractors.yaml; pyproject.toml/uv.lock; tests/unit/test_mert_contracts.py; tests/external/test_real_music_backends.py; music cookbook and CHANGELOG.md.
API: AudioStimulus plus model, immutable revision, layers, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False, explicit device and strict execution. Support cached source-pinned custom code only with explicit opt-in; give actionable BackendLoadError for the default refusal. Validate processor/config rates, integer layer domain including layer 0, duplicate/empty selections, finite inputs and short clips. Explicit channel policy; no hidden pooling/resampling/chunking.
Derive convolution stride, receptive field, center offset and exact output lengths from supported checkpoint geometry. Refuse unsupported geometry and inconsistent hidden-state lengths instead of truncating. Run eval and inference mode. Record supplied clip context including normalization and bidirectional attention; do not describe layer 0 as necessarily local.
Upstream checked 2026-10-06: MERT-v1-95M config has 24 kHz, stride product 320, 12 transformer layers and width 768; nominal rate is 75 Hz, not the speech adapters' 50 Hz. Config and processor must agree. Sources: https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/MERT-v1-95M/raw/main/config.json and https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/MERT-v1-95M .
Acceptance: hand-composed convolution timing/length oracle at boundary input sizes; distinguish selected layers using synthetic identifiable tensors; preserve clocks/support; deterministic evaluation; invalid rate/layer, missing asset, custom-code refusal, load/inference failures. Test inability to reach network in offline mode. Separately compare the adapter with direct inference on a pinned real checkpoint, same waveform/preprocessing, all selected layers and first/last timestamps.
Risk: custom-code/transformers compatibility and full-context memory cost. Pin a proven dependency combination; keep whole supplied-window inference and document costs rather than silently chunking.
Next action after contract: implement deterministic fake-backend tests, then adapter and optional real-model parity.
set.title: GitHub #9: add native-temporal layer-resolved MERT adapter
